messages:
Priya Singh: Quick sync 480480 NimbleHW marketplace bundle pilot goes live Mon. Need compact SI handoff rules, ownership TTL, and conflict resolution steps. Can we keep intake -> claim -> credit window simple?

Jon Rivera: I can take NA enterprise intake. Suggest TTL: 24h to claim, 6h for initial triage acknowledgement.

Lee Patel: Agree. Proposal for "enterprise": ARR >= 75k OR seats >= 150. Lower than our usual since marketplace leads tend to be SMB-expanding. Region routing: if account.region == EMEA -> SI_EU.

Maria Chen: Two program constraints: (1) Hardware partners require co-marketing signoff before joint customer contact, (2) SI must be onboarded in our co-sell roster to get credit. Add gating steps.

Priya Singh: Draft auto-routing snippet for ops automation:

```
# auto_route
- if account.tags contains "DS_OWNER" -> route = Sales_Direct (no_auto_claim)
- elif account.ARR >= 75000 OR account.seats >= 150 -> route = SI_Enterprise_Queue
- elif lead.requested_products intersects ["Nimble-Bundle", "Nimble-A100"] -> route = Nimble_SI_Queue, priority = high
- elif account.region == "EMEA" -> route = SI_EU_Queue
- else -> route = Marketplace_SDR_Queue
- claim_ttl_hours = 24
- triage_ack_hours = 6
- cosell_credit_window_hours = 48
```

Jon Rivera: Two operational notes: (a) If SI not named within cosell_credit_window -> mark as marketplace-owned. (b) If account has historical_si tag -> auto-notify that SI before claiming.

Lee Patel: For disputed claims: 1) post to #partnerships-triage with "dispute:<account_id>" 2) 6h wait for resolution from owners, 3) escalate to Dir Partnerships (Maria) at 24h.

Marketplace Ops Bot: Preview scan complete: 8 new leads this morning, 3 mapped to Nimble_SI_Queue. Dashboard: https://go.redwood/ops/leads/1730000123

Priya Singh: Action items: Jon -> NA enterprise intake + set 9am sweep; Lee -> update playbook with snippet and historical_si handling; Maria -> confirm co-marketing gating language and final escalation owner; Ops -> enable preview webhook to #partnerships-triage.

Jon Rivera: Setting sweep and calendar blocks. Will also create a stub in Salesforce for "marketplace_intake" record type.

Lee Patel: I'll PR the playbook and include the exclusion rules and historical SI ping. ETA tomorrow lunch.

Maria Chen: I'll finalize gating copy and add marketing contact list for Nimble. Also confirm escalation order.

Marketplace Ops Bot: Next automated preview scheduled: 1730003600. Conflicts will include tags and DS_OWNER exclusions.

Priya Singh: Great work. Let's keep this lean for the pilot; we can tighten thresholds after two weeks of telemetry. If anyone finds edge cases, ping #partnerships-triage. :handshake:
